# babysense-pro-firmware-update-mac

> Unofficial, open-source macOS tool that installs Babysense's official firmware update (V0207) on a Babysense Pro (MaxView Pro) baby monitor parent unit without a Windows PC. Babysense's own updater is a Windows-only Microsoft Store app; Babysense support recommends the update to fix the parent unit's "BATTERY CONDITION WARNING. The Battery In The Parent Unit Is In Poor Condition. Disconnect Your Power Adapter. The Unit Will Power OFF Automatically." screen.

Key facts:
- Usage: `brew install libusb`, clone the repo, run `./babysense-update install`, then unplug the USB-C cable, press RESET on the back of the parent unit, turn it on, and re-pair cameras (Menu > Camera Settings > Pair Camera).
- The tool downloads Babysense's updater from Microsoft's official Store servers, verifies it, extracts the firmware, and copies it to the parent unit as `firmware.bin` exactly as Babysense's Windows app does. It does not modify the firmware or bypass the battery check.
- The parent unit is USB device 0c45:8801 ("SN93701PU", drive "SONiXTek 510PF"). Its update drive does not appear in Finder because it is generated by the unit's firmware and macOS's disk driver cannot use it; the tool talks to it directly over USB (needs sudo).
- Do not update a unit whose battery is swollen or that was dropped or damaged; contact Babysense support instead.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): who this is for, safety, step-by-step instructions, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [How it works](docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md): technical notes on the parent unit's virtual FAT drive, the Windows copy order, and integrity checks
